metadata.description: Hardened target topology for the speak rewrite. Produced by an adversarial judge-panel (6 lenses → per-finding skeptic verification → synthesis): 50 findings, 41 survived majority refutation, 9 killed. v2 corrects v1's own errors (dropped blend-composition edge, over-reified sc:synthesize, speculative capability:streaming) and pins the schemas, migration, and CLI surface that v1 left as prose.
metadata.source: designed 2026-05-26; critique workflow wf_417e15fc-5a8 over speak @ 1a6c901 + uncommitted
metadata.extractor: claude (claude-opus-4-8) main-loop synthesis of 41 verified panel findings
key-design-moves: PERSONA / REALIZATION split, now i2t-faithful: a persona (engine-agnostic casting intent) has a realization ONLY where voices.yaml declares one. Absence of an engine key = the persona is honestly unavailable in that engine. There is NO fallback key and NO default realization, so leak #1 (voice-identity erasure) is structurally impossible, not policy-prevented.

REALIZATION is typed: realization-kind ∈ {named, blend, cloned, parametric}. A blend (e.g. 0.5 am_adam + 0.5 am_michael) is a first-class realization carrying component/weight structure — NOT a persona. The audit's i:blend-composition edge, which v1 wrongly dropped, is restored.

sc:resolve-voice is the binding event (persona + active-engine → resolved realization) that the audit had only implicitly. i:driver-reports-realization forces the on-screen badge to name the realization ACTUALLY rendered — this is the single change that kills the lying-badge bug. v1 fixed the data model but never wired the display, so it only relocated the lie.
ENGINE is a single config value (gemini|gcloud|kokoro). Mutual exclusion becomes impossible by construction — the -g/-k/-f/--no-gcloud guard triangle is deleted.

OPTIMIZER is a top-level concern, not an engine TTS model: it EMITS the audio-tags vocabulary; engines that CONSUME it list audio-tags in their capabilities. optimize fires iff (active engine lists audio-tags) AND (its own Gemini auth is satisfiable). Under kokoro the optimizer is skipped → genuinely offline by default.

Three synthesize edges (per-engine, n-ary over text/engine/model/realization/output) — NOT one positional-role edge. Polymorphism lives in the i:driver-calls-adapter-* dispatch edges. This is the i2t-faithful reading the panel preferred over v1's single edge.

CHUNKING is engine-agnostic and feeds synthesis through a shared data node (state:chunk-list), not an edge-to-edge 'feeds' incidence. Concurrency is data (policy:concurrency): cloud engines bounded-parallel (default 3), kokoro serial (1) — replacing the hardcoded batch_size=3.

STRANGLER refactor, not greenfield rewrite: the current 939-line driver is evolved in place; only the synth bodies are extracted into adapters (sc:extract-adapters records the provenance). Honors 'never rewrite' structurally.

DATA out of CODE with a fail-loud validation gate: voices.yaml + engines.yaml are validated against schemas at load; any unknown engine/persona/capability/blend-voice/model errors and exits nonzero. The driver MUST NOT contain a 'default realization' or 'nearest-voice' path.
metadata.language-decision: bash driver + bash cloud adapters (engines/gemini.sh, engines/gcloud.sh; curl-based, python3 only as a JSON/numeric helper) + python kokoro adapter (engines/kokoro.py, evolved from kokoro_tts.py). No venv unless engine=kokoro. The adapter contract is language-agnostic: a .sh and a .py adapter satisfy the same text+realization-id → wav+sidecars invocation convention.

voices-yaml-schema._doc: personas keyed by lowercase id; realizations keyed by ENGINE config-value; a realization is present IFF its engine key exists (no fallback, no default realization). Blend = list of {voice, weight}. Single-voice kokoro realization = {voice: X}. Schema allows EITHER {voice} OR {blend} under kokoro, never both.
voices-yaml-schema.note: voices.yaml enumerates ALL 30 personas explicitly. The 9 currently-mapped personas get their kokoro realization from kokoro_tts.py's mappings (puck→blend, charon→am_michael, kore→am_michael, zephyr→am_adam, fenrir→am_adam, leda→af_bella, orus→am_michael, aoede→af_sarah, callirrhoe→af_sky); the other 21 OMIT the kokoro key (honestly unavailable offline).

engines-yaml-schema._doc: engines keyed by config-value. 'capabilities' is the single source of truth the optimizer-gating edge reads. Optimizer is declared top-level, not under an engine.
engines-yaml-schema.kokoro_native_voices_carry: language_code per voice (am_adam: en-us, bm_george: en-gb, ...) — kills the bf_/bm_ string-prefix inference.

config-migration._doc: runs once, writes new config, errors on any unmappable value (never drops).
config-migration.voice=Puck: persona: puck (lowercase-normalize; FAIL if no matching persona)
config-migration.model_selection_precedence: --model flag > config model_overrides[engine] > engines.yaml models.default; --model takes a KEY (e.g. 'fast') or literal id, validated against that engine's models.

decisions-pending-user-confirmation._doc: v2 bakes in the recommended default for each; flagged here for the review gate. Override any and I re-emit v2.
decisions-pending-user-confirmation.missing-realization: DEFAULT: hard error, exit nonzero, never substitute; show which engines DO realize the persona. Optional --nearest flag as documented opt-in; when used, the badge MUST report the substitution.
decisions-pending-user-confirmation.command-name: DEFAULT: keep 'speak' (installed at /opt/homebrew/bin/speak, documented in services-registry).
decisions-pending-user-confirmation.wrangler-disposition: DEFAULT: omit from this graph — Cloudflare Workers is a DEPLOYMENT target, not a TTS engine; the .wrangler/ cache is a separate decision (keep/remove/promote-to-4th-engine).
decisions-pending-user-confirmation.kokoro-puck-casting: DEFAULT: keep the am_adam+am_michael 0.5/0.5 blend; flagged for Harold to confirm by ear or re-cast to a better-matching native voice.
decisions-pending-user-confirmation.blend-weight-normalization: DEFAULT: auto-normalize weights (forgiving); alternative is reject-if-not-sum-1.
decisions-pending-user-confirmation.chirp3-name-coverage: BUILD-TIME TODO: verify each en-US-Chirp3-HD-{name} against the live Chirp3 voice list before baking into voices.yaml; omit any that 404 (avoid silent-failure-deferred-to-runtime).
decisions-pending-user-confirmation.kokoro-concurrency: DEFAULT: per-engine max_in_flight in engines.yaml; kokoro=1 (serial), cloud=3.
decisions-pending-user-confirmation.kokoro-offline-default: DEFAULT: optimizer skipped under kokoro (no audio-tags capability) → no GEMINI_API_KEY required for a bare kokoro run. This is a deliberate behavior CHANGE from current (kokoro-without-raw still hits Gemini today).

metadata.anti-reification-discipline: A capability node is justified ONLY when at least one engine has a verified has-capability edge to it AND the source consumes it (audio-tags qualifies: Gemini consumes [tags] as prosody at speak.sh L613-623; streaming did not, so it is removed). persona/realization/contract:adapter/policy/concept nodes are reified because the design and help text treat each as a named, addressable thing. sc:resolve-voice and sc:resolve-voice-fails are reified state_change events because the binding/failure is a talkable occurrence the UX reports. sc:synthesize is NOT reified (v1's error, corrected): chunk and synthesize are both state_change edges sharing the state:chunk-list data node — the canonical i2t pipeline pattern.
what-this-graph-deliberately-omits: concept:narration-intelligence (audit) — subsumed: it was the named effect of sc:optimize applying capability:audio-tags; the optimize+capability pair now carries the meaning.
commit/history nodes — this is a target state, not a diff.
the full 30-persona enumeration — 4 representatives (puck, charon, leda, sulafat) illustrate the pattern; voices.yaml holds all 30.
engine-availability cross-fallback — explicitly NOT proposed (would resurrect leak #1); only honest readiness REPORTING via preconditions.

attrs.label: audio-tags vocabulary capability
attrs.gcloud-status: NOT held: Chirp3 ingests text as plain input.text and cannot interpret bracket tags — optimization would be wasted spend AND audio degradation, so skipped.
attrs.kokoro-status: NOT held: skipped → offline by default.

attrs.label: missing-realization policy
attrs.decided-behavior: error with actionable message naming which engines DO realize this persona; exit nonzero; never substitute. Optional --nearest opt-in only when the user asks, and then the badge reports the substitution.

attrs.label: synthesis concurrency policy
attrs.rule: per-engine max_in_flight from engines.yaml; cloud bounded-parallel (default 3, respects API rate limits); kokoro serial (1, local CPU/GPU-bound). Replaces hardcoded batch_size=3.

attrs.label: persona = casting intent, not a fixed timbre
attrs.statement: A persona is a casting intent (e.g. 'upbeat male'). Each engine realizes it with its best-matching voice; the same persona can sound different across engines — a documented, predictable contract, not a silent substitution.

attrs.label: coverage invariants
invariants: every engine's default persona has a realization in that engine
every realization label is a string the adapter will actually request
audio-tags claimed only by engines whose adapter consumes tags

attrs.label: engine readiness (deferred)
attrs.note: engines.yaml carries per-engine preconditions (env var | binary on PATH | model file | token obtainable); driver evaluates them for honest reporting (future 'speak engines'). NOT cross-engine fallback.

attrs.role: narration-director LLM; EMITS the audio-tags vocabulary

attrs.roles: PCM→WAV transcode (gemini adapter only) + WAV concat (driver)

attrs.role: JSON/numeric helper for bash driver + adapters; interpreter for kokoro adapter

attrs.label: Sulafat

attrs.label: (26 other personas)

attrs.label: reclassified containment→reference to match the audit's defines=reference treatment
strangler provenance: the current script's synth bodies are extracted into adapters; the driver is the same orchestration evolved in place
the binding event: (persona, active-engine) → resolved realization. Reified because the UX reports it.
(persona, active-engine) with no realization → persona-unrealized state; drives the honest error
raw text → audio-tag-annotated transcript. Fires iff active engine lists audio-tags AND optimizer Gemini auth is satisfiable.
text → ordered chunk-list. fires-when: word_count > threshold (default 500); below threshold text passes straight to synthesize (no subprocess overhead). Engine-agnostic.
attrs.cost-semantics: cloud: latency-only (enables bounded-parallel), does not reduce per-char billing; kokoro: local memory only

attrs.label: chunk-list → concurrent synthesis, bounded by policy:concurrency (per-engine max_in_flight)
n-ary over chunk-list, engine, model, realization, output. Polymorphism via i:driver-calls-adapter-*, not positional roles.

ordered wav-chunks → single WAV via ffmpeg -c copy. fires-when: num_chunks > 1 (single-chunk run cp's, skips concat). Partial-failure tolerant: continues with successful chunks, aborts only if all fail.

at load, before any synthesis: cross-check voices.yaml + engines.yaml against schemas; unknown engine/persona/capability/blend-voice/model → print file+key+value, exit nonzero. No fallback path exists.
optimize fires only if the active engine has audio-tags
the optimizer authenticates against Gemini INDEPENDENT of the synth engine's auth — engine=gcloud + optimize still needs GEMINI_API_KEY
each engine's default persona MUST have a realization in that engine (validation invariant) — a bare 'speak hi' never hits the unrealized error
dispatch by config.engine — this is where the polymorphism lives
all three adapters satisfy the same text+realization-id → wav+sidecars contract
gemini adapter ONLY: PCM s16le 24k mono → WAV; distinct from the driver's concat use of ffmpeg

THE lie-killer: the badge names the realization actually rendered, showing both requested persona and resolved realization when they differ (e.g. 'Puck → Kokoro blend'); collapses to one when identical
speak voices: lists personas for the ACTIVE engine with realization labels; unrealized ones shown dimmed with reason. speak voices --all = persona×engine coverage grid.
RESTORED from audit (v1 dropped it): the puck blend is 0.5 am_adam + 0.5 am_michael style vectors
static correspondence (persona realized by voice-id here) — reference, not interactivity
Sulafat has NO kokoro has-realization edge — the absence IS the honesty
gcloud AND kokoro skip the optimizer round-trip; stops a future reader re-adding a global optimizer for 'the cloud path'
the error names the engines where the persona DOES have a realization
policy:concurrency supplies per-engine max_in_flight to the fan-out
a named kokoro realization points at the underlying native voice (locale carried as data on the voice)
DEFERRED: driver evaluates per-engine preconditions for honest reporting; NOT cross-engine fallback
